_source: Homelengo HTML template (themesflat.co/html/homelengo) — measured from the live DOM at 1440px on 2026-10-20 (index, sidebar-grid, property-details-v1, add-property, dashboard).

typography.family: Manrope (single family for display and body). Yuva adds Onest as a glyph-only fallback because Manrope has no capital Ə (U+018F).
typography.section_subtitle: 14px, weight 600, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.8px, primary blue, centered
typography.page_title: 40px weight 700, left aligned, with a 14px count line beside it
typography.nav: 16px weight 600, active item underlined in primary

shape.flag_tags: pill, 28px tall, 12px weight 600, letter-spacing 0.8px; primary blue or black 30%

layout.header: 78px, logo + tagline left, nav next to it, outline 'Sign in' pill and primary 'Submit property' pill right
layout.hero: full-bleed photograph, centered headline + subline, two tab pills, wide white pill search bar with labelled fields split by vertical dividers, outline 'advanced' pill and primary 'Search' pill
layout.property_grid: 3 columns at 1440, image 3:2 with location over a bottom gradient, tags top-left
layout.location_strip: 6 tall photo cards (radius 16) with a white inner card at the bottom: count, name, round arrow button
layout.details: title + price row, feature/location row with square icon buttons, 3-up gallery, two columns: content left, bordered contact card right
layout.dashboard: #F7F7F7 page, white radius-12 panels, stat tiles with round icon, table with an ink header bar

design_style.composition: centered section headings, symmetric grids, generous but even whitespace
design_style.imagery: large bright daylight photography; blue skies; interiors with natural light
design_style.ornamentation: minimal — borders and pills; no gradients except the photo overlay

visual_effects.notes: Reference uses wow.js fade-ins; Yuva omits scroll reveals (reduced motion, no decorative animation).
